intro.helpLead: Ask ADA about certification, exams, renewals, the registry or the ADA curriculum. Start with the page that covers your question, or send a message below.
intro.contactLead: Send ADA a message with the form below, or write or call using the details further down the page.

form.title: Send a message
form.intro: If your question is about your own record, put your Doula ID in the message so ADA can find it. This form is not for complaints about a doula: use <concern>Report a concern</concern> instead.
form.required: Phone and topic are optional. All other fields are required.
form.name: Your name
form.phoneConsent: Optional. By sharing your mobile number, you agree that Asian Doula Alliance may text you about your inquiry and, if you are a doula in our network, about client matches, work orders and scheduling. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of any service. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
form.messageHint: Do not send ID documents, card numbers or medical details here.
form.consent: By sending this form, you agree that ADA may use these details to answer you. See the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
form.replyNote: ADA replies to the email address you give.
form.sent: Message sent. ADA will reply to the email address you gave.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.errorTooMany: Too many messages have been sent from this connection. Please try again later.
form.errorInvalid: Please check your name, email and message, then try again.
form.errorNetwork: Could not send your message. Check your connection and try again, or email {email}.

concern.title: Report a concern
concern.body: If you have a concern about an ADA-certified doula, report it to ADA at <mail>{email}</mail>. Violations of the ADA Code of Conduct may result in disciplinary action, including suspension or revocation of ADA certification.

security.title: If someone says they are from ADA
security.messagesValue: If a message asks you to send your ID, a password or a card number, do not reply. Forward it to <mail>{email}</mail>.
security.examsValue: ADA does not sell exam questions, scores or certificates. If someone offers you any of them, tell ADA.
security.certificatesValue: A certificate is real only if the registry has a matching record. <registry>Check the registry</registry>
